one_line: Vakataka king whose reign saw the late florescence of Ajanta’s great monasteries and murals.

appearance.age_look: Appears around 32–36 years old, medium-tall with a lean but regal build.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose, medium-brown Deccan complexion, neatly kept short mustache, soft but alert dark eyes with thick lashes, and a calm, composed default expression that shifts easily into a commanding gaze.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair drawn back into a high, smooth topknot (in the Vakataka–Gupta style) secured with a narrow gold circlet diadem set with a single red gemstone at the center of his forehead, the rest of the hair neatly coiled and not loose.
appearance.costume: He wears a finely pleated off-white cotton dhoti wrapped in the Deccan style and tied at the waist with a broad red silk sash, the dhoti falling to the ankles with a narrow gold border; over his left shoulder and across the chest is a soft, light-cream uttariya (shawl) with a subtle pale-green edge, leaving the overall torso modestly draped; his upper body is adorned with a simple yet dignified gold chest harness of two narrow diagonal bands crossing over the shawl, and layered gold necklaces including one medium-length beaded chain and one slightly longer with a small pendant; his arms have paired gold armlets with a slight floral motif and plain bangles at the wrists, and he wears delicate gold anklets; on his feet are simple brown leather sandals; his ears bear medium-length gold earrings with a small droplet form, and a thin tilaka of red pigment is marked vertically on his forehead beneath the circlet.
appearance.signature: A sheathed, gently curved steel sword with a simple iron hilt and small circular guard, suspended from a brown leather belt at his left hip, the wooden scabbard lacquered deep brown with a narrow gold band near the mouth.

ref_desc: Harishena is a medium-brown, oval-faced Vakataka king with a black high topknot under a gold circlet, wearing an off-white ankle-length dhoti, cream uttariya, red waist sash, gold jewellery, brown sandals, and carrying a deep-brown sheathed curved sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Harishena of Vatsagulma as a dignified 5th-century Deccan king: a medium-tall, lean man with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, neat short mustache, and calm, alert dark eyes, his thick black hair pulled into a high, smooth topknot secured by a narrow gold circlet with a single red gemstone at the center of his forehead and a thin red tilaka below it. Dress him in an off-white, finely pleated cotton dhoti wrapped in a historically accurate Deccan style, falling to the ankles with a narrow gold border, tied at the waist with a broad red silk sash. Drape a light-cream uttariya over his left shoulder and across his chest so his torso remains modestly covered, and add a simple gold chest harness of two narrow diagonal bands over the shawl. Give him layered gold necklaces, paired gold armlets with slight floral motifs, plain gold bangles, delicate gold anklets, and medium-length gold earrings with small droplet forms. Put simple brown leather sandals on his feet. At his left hip, attach his signature weapon: a gently curved steel sword in a deep-brown wooden scabbard with a narrow gold band near the mouth, hanging from a brown leather belt. Use an authentic palette of off-white, cream, red, gold, and brown, and show him in neutral, front, and slight angle poses to clearly display his face, topknot and circlet, jewellery, dhoti, uttariya drape, sandals, and sheathed sword for consistent redrawing.
